thread:
Casey (Marketing): Quick final checklist for Wednesday's "Scale & Serve" webinar 9:00 PT. Need owners for: reg confirmation copy + ICS, Zoom recording + retention, who slices clips, HubSpot mapping + gating. Keep it micro.

Dev (Events): I'll run greenroom + local OBS backup. Cloud recording ON. Suggest waiting room ON for panelist control.

Jo (Ops): replay-bot: confirm cloud recording webhook + S3 prefix. Also, do we want slide-change markers on?

replay-bot: Meeting scheduled: https://zoom.us/j/1010101010. Cloud recording enabled. Auto-transcript enabled. Webhook endpoint /hooks/zoom/replay-upload. S3 target: s3://redwood-marketing/scale-serve/2026-11-03/. markers_enabled: true.

Sam (Content): I'll take highlight edit + 3 social cuts (60s, 45s, 30s). Need master MP4 + per-speaker SRT + markers.csv. Preferred filenames: 20261103-scale-serve_master.mp4 and 20261103-scale-serve_speaker1.srt etc. SLA: highlights within 36h, social cuts within 24h.

Riley (Growth): HubSpot fields: attended (bool), source=webinar, tag=scale-serve-2026, survey_completed (bool). If company_domain matches our trial domain list set is_trial=true and trigger AE_notify. Flow: attended -> immediate replay + 1-question survey; no-show -> 3-step replay drip. Gate full master download behind survey_completed=true. Preview clips public.

Casey (Marketing): Registration confirmation copy (short): "You're in! Add to calendar  [Add to calendar]. Join live: <zoom link>. We'll email the replay, slides, and clips within 48 hours. Optional: leave a prep question now." Use that as reg page confirmation and initial email.

Dev (Events): Greenroom checklist: slides exported as PDF, local OBS rec path: /recordings/local/scale-serve-20261103.mp4, mic check 10m prior. I'll be in 30m early. Waiting room ON.

Jo (Ops): Webhook payload schema (example) will include: s3_mp4, s3_srt_list (comma-separated URLs), markers_csv_url, replay_url_ttl_days=10, company_domain, is_trial, editor_priority (string), replay_download_token (if gated). We'll emit editor_note_url when marketing flags urgent clips.

Sam (Content): If markers exist, editors will pick timestamps, but we need markers.csv. Please include speaker confidence scores in transcript metadata if possible.

Jo (Ops): Will include confidence metadata and markers.csv. Also adding field "preferred_language" if provided on registration so we can surface localized captions.

Riley (Growth): Add property "clip_requested" in HubSpot when someone asks for the full file. AE workflow: if is_trial=true and attended=true -> create task.

Casey (Marketing): Legal note: keep public replay TTL=10 days. Gate on survey for download OK per legal. I'll loop legal immediately.

Dev (Events): One ask: enable local OBS auto-split so we have a backup per segment. Ops, can you accept multi-file uploads?

Jo (Ops): Yes, webhook will accept multiple s3_mp4 entries (comma-separated). We'll standardize filenames and include a manifest.json URL in payload.

Sam (Content): Recap owners: Dev=greenroom+local backup, Jo=upload+webhook+manifest, Sam=edits+social, Riley=HubSpot mapping+drips, Casey=copy+templates. Any last blockers?

Riley (Growth): All set. I'll prepare HubSpot workflows and the survey micro-question.

Casey (Marketing): I'll drop the confirmation template to /assets/email-templates/scale-serve and ping #marketing. Thanks team :raised_hands:
